_comment: Crash log pattern configuration for HWASAN log parsing.

log_validation._comment: String required to identify a valid HWASAN log file.

fault_line._comment: Rules for parsing fault lines to extract fault address and thread ID.
fault_line._comment_tags_suffix: Memory tags sometimes follow the address; this suffix is stripped.

stack_frame._comment: Rules for parsing stack frame lines (e.g., '#0 pc 0x... module').

module_bracket_strip._comment: Module name may be wrapped in parentheses with an offset, e.g. (/lib/libc.so+0x1234). Strip both.

stack_frame._comment_module_colon_strip: Module name may be followed by ':line_number'; this colon separates them.

registers_section._comment: Rules for parsing register dump lines.
registers_section._comment_skip_prefixes: Lines with these prefixes are not register data and should be skipped.
registers_section._comment_value_separators: Separators between register name and value, tried in order.

memory_map._comment: Rules for parsing memory map lines.
memory_map._comment_end_marker: Indicates the end of the memory map section.
memory_map._comment_path_indicator: If a token contains this character, it is treated as a file path.

state_machine._comment: Trigger words for the parsing state machine.
state_machine._comment_ignore_stack_triggers: When these lines appear, ignore any following stack frames until a new section starts.

limits._comment_max_frames: Maximum number of stack frames to retain (reduce for performance).

module_matching._comment: Strategies for matching a frame's module name to a memory map entry.
module_matching._comment_strategies: exact: full path match; parent_dir: match if parent directories are the same.
